description: Payoff, P&L, and both breakeven prices for a long or short straddle/strangle (a call + a put on the same Deribit BTC/ETH underlying, both legs the same direction) at a scenario price. A straddle is callStrike === putStrike; any callStrike > putStrike makes it a strangle, same formula either way. Coin-settled like workflow.run_options_payoff: a long position's max loss is the flat total premium paid (between the strikes, both legs worthless); max profit is technically unbounded, dominated by the put leg's payoff as price falls toward zero. Use when user asks about a straddle or strangle, e.g. "what does a BTC straddle pay off if price barely moves?" or "where are my breakevens on this strangle?". Returns: combinedIntrinsicCoin, scenarioPnlCoin, scenarioPnlUsd, upperBreakevenPrice, lowerBreakevenPrice, maxLossCoin/maxProfitCoin (null = unbounded), isStraddle, isProfitable. With exchange "binance" (USDT-settled, flat payoff, callPremiumUsdt and putPremiumUsdt) it returns: totalPremiumUsdt, combinedIntrinsicUsdt, scenarioPnlUsdt, upperBreakevenPrice (call strike + total premium), lowerBreakevenPrice (put strike - total premium, null when that is not above zero), maxLossUsdt/maxProfitUsdt (null = unbounded: the long side's profit is unlimited, the short side's loss is unlimited); USDT is not converted to USD.

callPremiumCoin.description: Deribit only. Call leg premium per contract, in the base coin (e.g. 0.02 BTC)

callPremiumUsdt.description: Binance only. Call leg premium per unit, in USDT

callStrike.description: Call leg strike, USD. Equal to putStrike for a straddle, higher for a strangle.

currency.description: Underlying. Default BTC. XAU and XAG (gold, silver) only with exchange binance.

exchange.description: Venue whose settlement rules apply. "deribit" (default): BTC/ETH, coin-settled, premium in the base coin. "binance": BTC/ETH/XAU/XAG, USDT-settled, flat payoff max(0, S-K) per unit, premium in USDT (use the *Usdt premium fields); the result carries exchange and settlement fields.

putPremiumCoin.description: Deribit only. Put leg premium per contract, in the base coin

putPremiumUsdt.description: Binance only. Put leg premium per unit, in USDT

putStrike.description: Put leg strike, USD. Must be <= callStrike.

quantity.description: Number of straddle/strangle units (both legs sized equally)

scenarioPrice.description: Underlying price in USD to evaluate the payoff at

name: workflow.run_straddle_strangle
title: Straddle and Strangle
